meaning.zh:
“夜班” 或 “凌晨班”。

这个短语来源于19世纪，用于形容在深夜或者清晨时段工作的班次。因为这个时段往往非常安静、黑暗，与墓地（graveyard）的氛围相似，因此被称为 “墓地班次” 或 “凌晨班”。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the 19th century to describe work shifts that occur during the late-night or early morning hours. Because this time period is typically very quiet and dark, akin to the atmosphere of a graveyard, it became known as the "graveyard shift".

lines.en: He’s working the *graveyard shift* at the hospital this week.
It’s hard to adjust to the *graveyard shift* because of the sleep schedule.
lines.zh: 由于睡眠时间安排，适应夜班是很难的。

lines.en: The factory runs 24/7, so someone always needs to cover the *graveyard shift*.
lines.zh: 工厂全天运行，所以总是需要有人值夜班。
